label: MARKETING TERM
headline: What is Reach?
body: Reach tells you how many unique people saw your content or ad at least once. It's about the number of individual eyes on your message.
caption:
Think of it as the count of individual folks who spotted your social media post, email, or ad campaign. If one person sees your post five times, your reach is still one. It's a simple way to understand your unique audience size for a specific piece of content. Knowing your reach can help you understand how widely your message is spreading. Keep an eye on it to see who you're connecting with! 👀
